name: Northern Bear Paw RV Park
note: RV park in the pines off M-55 west of Tawas City; back-in full-hookup 50/30/20-amp sites sized 32-40 ft with tow-vehicle parking beside each, small pond by the entrance loop. Reservable online. name: Northern Nights Family Campground
note: Family campground in Roscommon a few miles from Higgins Lake; full-hookup 30/50-amp sites up to 40-44 ft, concrete-pad pull-throughs, rustic tent/van sites, rental house; open for a winter season as well as summer. Reservable online. FHU sites $49.50/night weeknights in June (2027 quote), $39.95 in October. RV Life 4.5*/$$$ ~$48/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude

name: Sharp Park Campground
note: Family campground on a small lake at 8551 Deep Lake Rd north of Middleville; full-hookup sites with a row of lakeside sites along the shore, cabins, camp store, kayak/canoe/paddleboat rentals, themed events all season. Reservable online. 2026 full hookup (non-lakeside) $45 Sun-Thu, $50 Fri-Sat; lakeside sites cost more; weekly $300. RV Life 4.5*/$$$ ~$43/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude

name: The Campground
note: Small RV park on M-42 east of Manton (10330 E M-42); 16 sites with 20/30/50-amp, water, most with sewer, pull-through and wooded back-in, bathhouse, walking trails. Books through Campspot (the park's own domain no longer resolves). FHU sites $50/night (fall 2026 quote); weekly $300. Campspot 5.0 over 21 verified reviews. RV Life 5*/$$$ ~$42/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude

name: Bay Ridge RV Park & Campground
note: Open RV park on a slope above Garden Bay on the Garden Peninsula; 41 full-hookup sites, many 50-85 ft and several pull-through ('not recommended for motorcoaches' on some), 'Great View' sites facing the bay, camper rental. Season May 1 - Oct 31; 2-night minimum online (call for 1 night). 2026 daily $40, Great View $50; weekly $280. RV Life 4*/$$$ ~$47/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude
